Title: Generally available: CI/CD Guidance for Azure IoT Central

Body.Content:
Continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) refers to the process of developing and delivering software in short, frequent cycles using automation pipelines. We have released guidance and sample code to help you integrate your Azure IoT Central applications into your own Azure pipelines. Learn how to automate the build, test, and deployment of IoT Central application configuration, to deliver reliable releases more frequently. 

Learn more about integrating Azure IoT Central into Azure Pipelines for CI/CD
